name: Syntec Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Syntec Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, sales, and maintenance of industrial electronic automation controllers in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company also offers design and technical service of maintenance for factory machinery automation systems. Its products include controllers, motors, and encoders, servo products for metalworking, woodworking, laser and other industries. In addition, the company offers machine tools, electronic control equipment, laser equipment, and electrical machinery. Syntec Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
